//: Every command in stage1 was run once, in this project, before being written here.
//verification: The one thing this repository cannot work out for you: what checks this project has, and where the change stops being under your control once it ships. artifact_kind: service | library | cli | chart | migration | model-boundary | plugin.

stage2: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'working tree is not clean: the artifact would not be the revision under test'; exit 1; }
cargo build --release -p llama-helper && mkdir -p frontend/src-tauri/binaries && cp target/release/llama-helper frontend/src-tauri/binaries/llama-helper-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
cd frontend && npx --yes pnpm@11 run build && ./node_modules/.bin/tauri build --bundles appimage --config '{"build":{"beforeBuildCommand":""},"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":false}}'

umask 077; S2=$(mktemp -d /tmp/backchannel-stage2.XXXXXX) && mkdir -p "$S2/home" && printf '%s\n' "$S2" > .git/backchannel-stage2-root && git rev-parse HEAD > "$S2/expected-sha" && APP=$(ls -t target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage | head -1) && test -x "$APP" && printf '%s\n' "$APP" > "$S2/app"

S2=$(cat .git/backchannel-stage2-root) && APP=$(cat "$S2/app") && (HOME="$S2/home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$S2/home/.config" XDG_DATA_HOME="$S2/home/.local/share" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$S2/home/.cache" GDK_BACKEND=x11 nohup "$APP" > "$S2/stdout.log" 2>&1 & echo $! > "$S2/pid") && sleep 20 && kill -0 "$(cat "$S2/pid")"

S2=$(cat .git/backchannel-stage2-root) && T=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('frontend/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json'))['app']['windows'][0]['title'])") && WID=$(xwininfo -root -tree | grep -F "\"$T\"" | grep -v mutter-x11-frames | head -1 | awk '{print $1}') && xwd -id "$WID" -out "$S2/window.xwd" && test -s "$S2/window.xwd" && echo "window dump: $S2/window.xwd"

S2=$(cat .git/backchannel-stage2-root) && kill "$(cat "$S2/pid")"; sleep 2; S2=$(cat .git/backchannel-stage2-root) && case "$S2" in /tmp/backchannel-stage2.*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac && test -d "$S2" && rm -rf -- "$S2" && rm -f -- .git/backchannel-stage2-root
verification.notes: Product: a Tauri 2 desktop app (Linux AppImage/.deb, macOS .dmg, Windows .exe); artifact_kind 'cli' is the closest kind in the schema for a locally installed application. Development and every verification run happen on Linux only (ADR 0005); macOS and Windows are built in CI and are never proven here - a verdict names them as not proven. Stage 1 gaps recorded on 2026-09-02: (1) frontend/tests/lib/live-transcription-event-names.test.mjs reads src-tauri/src/audio/transcription/stream_worker.rs, which was renamed to adapters/streaming.rs - stale, fails; (2) frontend/tests/lib/blocknote-markdown.test.ts and summary-language-preferences.test.js import bun:test and Bun is not installed - not run; (3) Rust test audio::device_detection::tests::test_calculate_buffer_timeout_bluetooth fails on float rounding (159.999996ms vs 160ms) and is skipped explicitly; 3 other Rust tests are #[ignore]. Nothing in the repository or CI ran any of these tests before; the first issue fixes them and then the skip and the file list are replaced by the full suites. (4) frontend/package.json has no packageManager pin while CI uses pnpm 11 and the workspace file needs pnpm >= 10; on this machine run frontend scripts with `npx pnpm@11` until the pin lands. Stage 2 prerequisites: the llama-helper sidecar must be built and copied first (`cargo build --release -p llama-helper` then copy target/release/llama-helper to frontend/src-tauri/binaries/llama-helper-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, exactly the CI step); ffmpeg is fetched by build.rs. Release facts that matter for delivery: release.yml builds macOS and Windows only, Linux bundles exist only as CI artifacts; the updater endpoint, Homebrew cask and Scoop bucket still point at bykof/conversationaly (upstream), not at this fork - a rebrand issue, not a Stage 2 step.

verification.//stage2: The boundary is the installed desktop application: the AppImage built from the tree under test, launched on a clean profile (fresh HOME/XDG dirs) as a first-time user would. Evidence: the process stays alive, a top-level window with the configured title exists, the log reports setup complete without a panic, and a window dump is captured. GDK_BACKEND=x11 makes the window observable with xwininfo/xwd under Wayland; the Wayland code path is therefore not what this smoke observes. Real audio and UI flows are not covered yet: the PipeWire virtual-device harness and a working computer-use CLI are separate issues; until then a verdict names them as not proven.
